en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

p.src: 1  I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

en: I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
u.src: 1  I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

p.src: 2  He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

en: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
u.src: 2  He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

p.src: 3  He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

en: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
u.src: 3  He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

p.src: 4  Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

en: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
u.src: 4  Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

p.src: 5  Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

en: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.
u.src: 5  Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

p.src: 6  Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

en: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
u.src: 6  Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

p.src: 7  Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

en: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.
u.src: 7  Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

p.src: 8  I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

en: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
u.src: 8  I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

p.src: 9  I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.

en: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.
u.src: 9  I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.

p.src: 10  I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

en: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
u.src: 10  I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

p.src: 11  Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

en: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
u.src: 11  Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

p.src: 12  For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

en: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
u.src: 12  For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

p.src: 13  Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.

en: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.
u.src: 13  Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.

p.src: 14  Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

en: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.
u.src: 14  Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

p.src: 15  Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

en: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
u.src: 15  Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

p.src: 16  Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”

en: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”
u.src: 16  Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”

p.src: 17  But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.

en: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
u.src: 17  But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
